The New Forest is a stunning national park in southern England, known for its ancient woodlands, open
heathlands and free-roaming ponies. Originally created as a royal hunting ground by William the
Conqueror in 1079. It is now a protected area rich in wildlife and history. Visitors can explore scenic
walking, cycling trails, spot deer & rare birds and visit charming villages like Lyndhurst and
Brockenhurst. Whether you're looking for outdoor adventure or a peaceful escape, the New Forest
offers a unique blend of natural beauty and heritage.
First time to TheNewForest?
